findings.reason: Ticket revision v8 requires a distinct material reference incompatibility to persist stale/invalidated state with a typed reason, while the approved design limits CompatibilityCheckerV1 and its closed typed reason taxonomy to capability, scope-binding and policy identity/version/digest mismatches. Guide v7 cannot invent a reference mismatch reason or silently reinterpret it as a binding reason.
findings.next_action: Return to Design/ticket-contract clarification before sealing guide v7. The recommended correction is to restore the approved design split: material capability/scope-binding/policy incompatibility is stale, while malformed, integrity, trust, key and expiry reference denials fail closed and require a new proposal without inventing a new CompatibilityReason.

findings.reason: The post-acquisition denial matrix omits protected-scope corruption and reference expiry even though both are reachable admission checks; TC-04 supplies only the time boundary and TC-10 consumes the incomplete TC-03 matrix.
findings.next_action: After contract clarification, add exact protected-scope-corruption and reference-expiry rows with ProposalNotExecutable(resource_access_denied), HTTP 403 TOOL_RESOURCE_ACCESS_DENIED, independently sourced durable identities, zero admission/audit/gateway/provider activity, TC-04 clock linkage and TC-10 post-restart non-finalization evidence.
